full_judgment: 23. The teamed Single Judge on total misreading of the case of the defendant-petitioner gave an adverse finding that the date of knowledge was a subsequent interpolation in her application for restoration of the suit, though no such case was made out in the revision application. The finding of the learned Judge that "Even if it is assumed that the application filed in the Miscellaneous case mentioned the date of knowledge of the defendant no. 1 in respect of the ex-parte decree but since this was not proved either by oral or documentary evidence by the defendant No. 1 is the result of non-consideration of the case of the plaintiff as made out in her application udder Order 1X, ride 13 of the Code and the deposition of PW1 in that respect.
